'''Football Club Domagnano''', commonly referred to as '''FC Domagnano''' or simply '''Domagnano''', is a [[San Marino|Sanmarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Domagnano]]. The club was founded in [[1966 in association football|1966]]. Domagnano currently plays in [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colors are red and yellow.
Previously known as '''SP Domagnano''', the side has been one of the most successful teams in the Campionato Sammarinese. In the 2004–05 season, Domagnano won the championship with a [[play-off]] win over [[S.S. Murata]]. As the [[San Marino|Sammarinese]] champions, Domagnano entered the [[UEFA Cup]] but was defeated easily in the first qualifying round.  Some of Domagnano's rivals are [[S.S. Pennarossa]] and [[A.C. Libertas]]."}}
